_comment: This is the FULL body for the Shopify HTTP module. Put the minified mutation from shopify-productSet.graphql as the 'query' string. Build the 'variables.input' object with a Create JSON module (step 6) so arrays/metafields serialize correctly, then reference its output here. {{...}} are Make mappings from earlier modules: module 4 = parsed OpenAI JSON, module 5 = SERP result.
query: mutation CreateProduct($input: ProductSetInput!) { productSet(input: $input, synchronous: true) { product { id handle title status onlineStorePreviewUrl } userErrors { field message } } }

_notes.status: Start with DRAFT. Switch to ACTIVE only after you trust the output.
_notes.files: Omit this whole array (or leave originalSource empty) when the SERP step returned no image — the product still creates. Invalid image URLs surface in media[].status / mediaUserErrors but do NOT block product creation.
_notes.compareAtPrice: Remove this line if compare_at_price is null, or keep it — null is accepted.
_notes.metafields: One object per metafield. type MUST match the Shopify metafield definition. For list.* types, value is a JSON-encoded string e.g. "[\"Cotton\",\"Linen\"]". Send me your real list and I'll finalize this array.
_notes.variants_with_options: If you later want size/color variants, add input.productOptions:[{name, values:[{name}]}] and give each variant optionValues:[{optionName, name}].
